clarity.notes: Three routes to the same spec, none of them SQL: tick a facet value, drag the timeline, or edit a lane. Whichever you use the other two update, so there is never a second copy of the query. Hiding the builder keeps the question visible - the head reads it back as words ('level is error - by service').

hierarchy.notes: The layout is now the log-explorer grammar: facets left, volume-over-time on top, results below, one record to the right. The timeline is the orienting element, which is correct for logs; the collapsed query head costs 34px instead of 290.

typography.notes: Inter for lane and facet labels, Fira Code for every value, count, percentile, axis stamp and SQL token. Tabular numerics on facet counts so the column does not jitter as the query narrows.

motion.notes: Three moves, all 90ms and all disclosure: the builder caret, the facet caret, the JSON twisty. The drag band tracks the pointer with no easing, which is right - it is a direct manipulation, not an animation.

brand.notes: Timeline levels use the semantic status colors (error/warning/info) for their semantic role, not decoration. Accent-2 stays on the selection band, facet ticks and data bars at 52% - a data bar, not an accent wash. Compact scale honoured: 22px facet rows, 24px value rows, 26px pills.
